summary:
Implemented the five missing methods in src/main/java/inventory/Inventory.java (the only file changed):
- remove(sku): returns Optional.ofNullable(items.remove(sku)).
- restock(sku, amount): throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown sku or non-positive amount; otherwise replaces the item with item.withQuantity(q + amount) and returns it.
- take(sku, amount): throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown sku/non-positive amount, IllegalStateException when quantity < amount; otherwise decrements and returns the updated item.
- lowStock(threshold): items with quantity strictly below threshold, sorted by sku.
- totalByCategory(): LinkedHashMap summing quantities per category, preserving first-seen category order.
